review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines `weightedBlockSize`, which is max 1 (card ι) times the product of the weights. It also has a private splitting lemma and `exists_weightedBlocks`. I searched Mathlib for `weightedBlock` and `BlockSize` and found nothing. I found no other Mathlib concept for a uniform block weight at which every multiple-weight exponent vector splits into equal-weight blocks. The file builds on Mathlib's `Finsupp.weight`, `degree`, `equivFunOnFinite` and `exists_le_degree_eq`, and does not re-implement them. `weightedBlockSize` is a specific numeric constant, not a competing version of an existing concept. The only other uses of the name are in other files of this library, and I did not read them. I make no finding under this rubric.
